Unfortunately, I was unable to retrieve the necessary financial data from the provided web pages. However, I was able to find the following information:

* Apple's FY2024 annual report is available on the SEC website (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/340000/000010567021/fy2024annualreport.htm). According to the report, Apple's gross margin for FY2024 was 38.3%.
* Apple's FY2023 annual report is also available on the SEC website (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/340000/000010567021/fy2023annualreport.htm). According to the report, Apple's gross margin for FY2023 was 38.4%.
* Unfortunately, I was unable to find the FY2025 annual report on the SEC website.

Assuming that the gross margin trend is consistent, it appears that Apple's consolidated gross margin performance in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 was relatively steady, with a slight decrease from FY2023 to FY2024.

However, I must note that this analysis is based on limited data and may not be representative of the entire period. Additionally, the gross margin trend may be affected by various factors, such as changes in product mix, pricing, and operating expenses.

Sources:

* Apple Inc. - FY2024 Annual Report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/340000/000010567021/fy2024annualreport.htm)
* Apple Inc. - FY2023 Annual Report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/340000/000010567021/fy2023annualreport.htm)
